intro: Eritrea's economy is small, based on mining, farming and money from abroad.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Copper, zinc and gold from the Bisha mine are the main exports. Most people farm or herd. Eritreans abroad often pay a 2% tax to the state.

chapters.title: Coast
text: The ports of Massawa and Assab could link Ethiopia to the sea.

keyTerms.meaning: A tax paid by citizens living abroad.

cardGroups.title: Made in Eritrea
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Eritrea makes and sells to the world.
